pass_a_gloss: Soils unto hundredfold martyrdom; God's tillage and building; paradise pleasures.
pass_b_english: The sower sowed: some seed fell by the wayside, some on rocky places, some among thorns, some on good ground — and yielded, one a hundredfold. Rocky ground received with joy but, having no root, in tribulation and persecution for the word straightway is offended. Good ground is he who heareth the word and understandeth, bearing fruit unto martyrdom hundredfold. Be God's tillage, God's building: 'for we are God's fellow-workers; God's tillage, God's building ye are.' Planted in the Lord's house, blossom in the courts of our God, and taste paradise's pleasures, which eye saw not (Matthew 13:3–23) (1 Corinthians 3:9) (Psalm 92:13) (1 Corinthians 2:9).
